name: QuantGym Collector
shortDescription: Record visible quant interview problems into your QuantGym study board.
detailedDescription: QuantGym Collector helps QuantGym beta users record a problem that is visible in the current browser viewport. When the user clicks Record, the extension captures the active tab screenshot, attaches lightweight page context such as title and source URL, opens QuantGym, and sends the capture to the QuantGym web app for OCR/vision extraction and saving. A JSON copy fallback remains available for text-based captures. The extension runs only after explicit user action and does not collect page content in the background.
singlePurpose: Record the current visible problem into QuantGym for study tracking.

permissionJustifications.activeTab: Used only after the user opens the popup, so the extension can read the active problem page.
permissionJustifications.scripting: Used to run the page extraction script on the active tab after user interaction.
permissionJustifications.storage: Used to remember the user's preferred QuantGym board URL locally in Chrome.
permissionJustifications.tabs: Used after the user clicks Record to capture the visible active tab, open QuantGym in an inactive tab, send the capture, and then focus QuantGym.

reviewNotes: Host permissions are limited to quantgym.app so the bridge script can deliver user-triggered captures to the QuantGym web app.
Captured content is sent only after the user clicks Record, and the screenshot is processed by the user's configured QuantGym LLM endpoint through the signed-in web app.
